title: Long code experiment variable
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let a sign tester have a finite seed set, and fix a long code experiment sample and one input position of its selected check. The associated variable is the pair consisting of the vertex reached from the sampled vertex along the sampled neighbor and the query at that position after applying the game's permutation for that edge.
